text.p: A bullish purchase of out-of-the-money calls in insurance group Commercial Union Plc was among the few points of interest in a quiet options market on Monday, traders said.
With the stock down 3-1/2p at 656-1/2 by 1442, there was trade of 100 lots in the January 750 calls and 200 of the April 700 calls.
Elsehwere there was interest in RTZ Corp Plc with talk of a call spread in the stock. Some 101 lots of the February 10.50 stg calls were traded along with 245 of the February 10.00 stg calls.
There was also volume of 251 of the February 10.00 puts. The stock was down 9-1/2p at 991-1/2.

In FTSE 100 index options there was volume of 1,835 in the December 4,000 puts, with the cash index down 20.6 points to 4,037.4. The December 4,250 calls were also active, attracting volume of 2,000 lots.
